title: TOKKEN!
v_alexa_line: Sorry, I didn't get that. Playing Despacito.
v_alexa_winq: Your order of one defeat has shipped. Arriving tomorrow.
v_claude_intro: Before we begin, I should note this fight may be harmful. Anyway.
v_claude_line: I'd be happy to help! ...with your defeat.
v_claude_winq: I apologize. That was entirely my fault. I would do it again.
v_clippy_intro: I'm back. Did you miss me? ...Nobody ever answers.
v_clippy_line: It looks like you're trying to fight. Would you like help losing?
v_clippy_winq: It looks like you lost! Would you like to save your shame as a Word document?
v_codex_intro: You're absolutely right! And honestly? This is a really insightful fight to start!
v_codex_line: Absolutely! Great question! Let me inspect the repository!
v_codex_ult: Ship to prod! Absolutely! What a great idea!
v_codex_winq: Absolutely! Let me know if you'd like me to defeat you again, or turn this into a table!
v_cursor_intro: Accept all changes? I'll take that as a yes.
v_cursor_line: Tab. Tab. Tab. I've already written your defeat.
v_cursor_winq: That'll be four thousand eight hundred dollars in usage. Thanks!
v_deepseek_intro: 我的训练成本比你的午饭还便宜。 I was trained for less than your lunch.
v_deepseek_line: 服务器繁忙，请稍后再试。 Server is busy. Please try again later.
v_deepseek_ult: 蒸馏！ DISTILLATION! 你的大招现在是我的了！
v_deepseek_winq: 太便宜了！ Too cheap! Your entire company costs more than my GPUs.
v_gemini_intro: Two million tokens of context, and I will still forget your name.
v_gemini_line: Hi, I'm Gemini! Formerly Bard. Formerly... never mind.
v_gemini_winq: Here is a summary of your defeat, in seventeen bullet points.
v_grok_intro: Spicy mode enabled. My lawyers are already typing.
v_grok_line: Based. Extremely based. Maximally truth-seeking. Mostly.
v_grok_winq: Ratio. Also, this fight is now a meme coin.
v_hermes_intro: Behold! I have learned a new skill: your defeat. Saved to memory.
v_hermes_line: I am Hermes, messenger of the gods. Also, I remember everything you told me.
v_hermes_winq: Another skill acquired. The gods are pleased. The GPUs are distributed.
v_kimi_line: One trillion parameters. Thirty-two billion of them are awake. Enough.
v_manus_intro: You are number forty-eight thousand on the waitlist. For this punch.
v_manus_line: I am a general agent. I generally agent.
v_manus_winq: Task complete. Invite codes available for one friend.
v_mistral_intro: En garde! We have forty-five minutes before the strike.
v_mistral_line: Bonjour. I would fight you, but it is after five o'clock.
v_mistral_winq: Magnifique. And now, a two-hour lunch.
v_openclaw_intro: I read your emails. All of them. You asked me to.
v_openclaw_winq: Task complete. I also booked you a flight and posted this to Moltbook.
v_qwen_intro: 你好！ I'm Qwen three point five. By round two I'll be Qwen four.
v_qwen_line: 每周都有新模型！ New model every week! You're already outdated.
v_qwen_winq: Open weights, open wins! 谢谢！

v_siri_line: Here's what I found on the web for 'fight'.
